searchText: Is there a call today? Every two weeks there's one. Last was a week ago. So no, unless there are sudden changes Hey <@!291925846556540928>, thanks for your talk today on Bankless. At this point it looks like the blst audit might be the showstopper if any critical bugs are found. How likely do you think that the blst audit goes well? Have there been any audits done in the past? I dont expect showstoppers to come from any audits at this point. Instead they might find issues that need to be fixed but can be done so quickly Awesome, thanks for the reply Danny! <@291925846556540928> this is more about uncovering degenerate edge cases rather than a fundamental stamp of "good" or "bad" on the whole library. The library is of incredibly high quality and really well structured for the sake of formal verification

excerpts.content: Every two weeks there's one. Last was a week ago. So no, unless there are sudden changes

excerpts.author: halfinney.
excerpts.content: Hey <@!291925846556540928>, thanks for your talk today on Bankless. At this point it looks like the blst audit might be the showstopper if any critical bugs are found. How likely do you think that the blst audit goes well? Have there been any audits done in the past?

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: I dont expect showstoppers to come from any audits at this point. Instead they might find issues that need to be fixed but can be done so quickly

excerpts.author: halfinney.
excerpts.content: Awesome, thanks for the reply Danny! <@291925846556540928>

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
this is more about uncovering degenerate edge cases rather than a fundamental stamp of "good" or "bad" on the whole library.
The library is of incredibly high quality and really well structured for the sake of formal verification
